session: one session, one idle RTX 5090, both engines back to back

host.note: 185 MiB is Xorg + gnome-shell; the card was confirmed drained to it between engines

tabby_patches_reverted: the Phase 0 sep="\n" EventSourceResponse transport patch — the client-side hardening in bench_serve_sweep.py subsumes it

client.tokenizer: the pinned 2.25 snapshot, shared by every lane
client.protocol: random dataset, 512 in / 128 out, --ignore-eos, N=8/24/48/64 at c=1/4/8/16, 1 discarded warmup, 2 recorded reps, 1 Hz nvidia-smi poll

fp16.why: the largest fp16 pool that both boots AND survives a 512-token prefill at c=16

q4.why: validated under load; 32768 boots but OOMs mid-request. The usable ceiling was not bisected between 16384 and 32768.

caveat_ignore_eos: tabby's exllamav3 backend does not honour ignore_eos; measured 93-99 % of the 128-token cap per request, so it does 1-7 % less decode work per request than emmy, which honours it exactly.
